items.title: Keep dog 'Bruno' on a leash (max. 2m) outside your enclosed property
items.quote:
ordne ich hiermit gemäß § 14 Abs. 1 OBG NRW an, dass Ihr Hund
außerhalb Ihres befriedeten Besitztums ab sofort an einer höchstens zwei Meter langen Leine zu
führen ist.
items.computation: The order takes effect 'ab sofort' (immediately) upon notification (Bekanntgabe) of the Ordnungsverfügung. The letter is dated Thursday 15.05.2025 and was sent by post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW, a letter sent by ordinary post is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after posting, i.e. 18.05.2025 (Sunday) — the fictional delivery date is not shifted for weekends since it only fixes the notification date, not a deadline for the recipient to act by. The leash obligation therefore applies from that date onward (ongoing duty, no fixed end date).

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Verwaltungsgericht against the Ordnungsverfügung
items.quote:
Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Klage beim
Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, Justizzentrum, Gerichtsstraße 5, 44135 Musterstadt, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 15.05.2025, sent by post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW the letter is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after posting = 18.05.2025 (Sunday). The one-month Klagefrist (§ 74 VwGO) runs from Bekanntgabe: per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (18.05.2025) is not counted, so the period begins 19.05.2025. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day preceding commencement, i.e. the day numerically corresponding to 18 May → 18 June 2025 (Wednesday). 18.06.2025 is a regular working day in NRW (Fronleichnam, the nearest NRW holiday, falls on 19.06.2025), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Deadline: 18.06.2025.

warnings: A Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) of 250,00 € is threatened only in case of future non-compliance with the leash requirement; it is not currently due and no payment instructions/IBAN should be used for it without a separate formal demand.
No Widerspruch is possible ('Ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt') — only direct Klage to the Verwaltungsgericht within one month of notification.
